onboarding.title: How OpenDoor works
onboarding.body: One login. Chat in the browser, a house of OpenBot coworkers, and a shared credit pool. Pick your region so we speak your context — we never block a country.
onboarding.pickRegionHint: This only changes copy and defaults. Every region can sign up.
onboarding.productChatBody: Open Chat and talk to models on your phone or laptop. You do not need an API key to start.
onboarding.productHouseBody: OpenBot is a house of coworkers — one leader plus specialists you add. They share the same workspace.
onboarding.productPoolBody: Family and Team share one credit pool. One bill, not a closed-API key per person.

africa.school: School: light pages on a phone, a Student seat for class or homework, and no extra data just to reach a model.
africa.family: Family: one shared pool for the household. Parents and kids use the same credits — cheaper than four separate bills, and built for mobile data costs.
africa.team: Team: one workspace for the lab, NGO, or shop. Invite by email. Everyone shares the org pool.

europe.school: School: Student onboarding for a class or lab, with the same gateway path as Pro.
europe.family: Family: a household pool with rollover — one membership for the home.
europe.team: Team: SSO and shared controls when you are ready. Enterprise is talk to sales.

americas.school: School: Student is the membership for homework and labs. Same models as Pro.
americas.family: Family: a shared house pool for the household, cheaper than four Pro seats.
americas.team: Team: self-serve seats. Enterprise is residency, SCIM, and sales.

asia_pacific.school: School: start on a phone. Student covers the seat; tokens stay warehouse-priced.
asia_pacific.family: Family: one pool for the household so data and seats are not bought four times.
asia_pacific.team: Team: one workspace, invite coworkers, share credits.

middle_east.school: School: Student setup for class and research. Arabic is a first-class language.
middle_east.family: Family: a shared household pool — one bill for the house.
middle_east.team: Team: shared workspace and SSO when you need it. Enterprise via sales.

getStarted.title: Choose your path.
getStarted.body: OpenDoor adapts to school, family, and team. Pick a region first if you like — nobody is geo-blocked.
getStarted.startFreeBody: Self-serve for a person or small team. Continue with email.
getStarted.educationBody: For schools, labs, and students. Onboarding stays school-shaped.
getStarted.enterpriseBody: Existing orgs sign in with SSO. New deployments start with sales.

gettingStarted.title: Welcome to OpenDoor
gettingStarted.coreDone: Core setup is done. Optional steps below are there when you need them.
gettingStarted.coreTodo: Chat and a coworker get you into the product. Everything else is optional.

pricing.familyHeadline: A shared pool for your household

tools.searchOneLiner: Ask a question. OpenDoor Search answers with citations on our stack — billed on your credits, no third-party search keys.

openbot.houseBody: A house is your OpenBot workspace: a leader coworker plus specialists you add. They share channels, skills, and this org’s credit pool. Start a channel to talk; add a coworker when you want a named role.

settings.languageRegionHint: Used on login, onboarding, and first-run copy. The rest of the dashboard stays in English for now.
